about: Exceptions for scripts/offline-scan.mjs. Keep it small: every entry names what it lets through and why that is not a network load and not a price or upgrade prompt. A URL in a load position (src=, <link href>, url(), @import, fetch(, …) is never allowed, whatever this file says.
budgetWhy: Proposed size budget for Resources/Zest (ADR 0015, risk 3): 8 MB. Measured at 6.81 MB on 2026-11-13, of which Mermaid is 3.41 MB and the fonts 2.00 MB; the headroom covers phase 2's in-app switches and a library bump, not a new library.

urls.why: XML namespace names (xmlns): identifiers, never fetched
the DOCTYPE system identifier in ZestMail's exported email; browsers never fetch a DTD
the RFC 2606 example domain: sample data in ZestMail's default brand and Zest MD's sample document
a placeholder in the Open Graph snippet ZestImage copies for the user's own site (.example is reserved)
the website field of ZestMail's sample brand, shown as a footer link in the email; a link is not a load
linkify-it, inlined in Zest MD: prefixes a bare www. address with http:// to make a link's href; a link is not a load
comments in the copy of highlight.js inlined in Zest MD
library code pinned in VENDOR.lock.json: its URLs are documentation links, license banners and namespace names. A URL in a load position in vendor/ still fails
